vocab.example: We fell short of the deadline by one week on my first project.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đã trễ hạn một tuần trong dự án đầu tiên của tôi.

vocab.meaning_vi: đánh giá thấp, ước lượng thiếu
vocab.example: I underestimated the testing time, so bugs appeared in the final week.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã ước lượng thiếu thời gian kiểm thử, nên lỗi xuất hiện vào tuần cuối.

vocab.example: I went to my manager early to admit a mistake instead of hiding it.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã gặp quản lý sớm để thừa nhận sai sót thay vì giấu đi.

vocab.example: The first warning sign was that two tasks slipped in the same week.
vocab.example_vi: Dấu hiệu cảnh báo đầu tiên là hai đầu việc cùng bị trễ trong một tuần.

vocab.meaning_vi: lên tiếng sớm về vấn đề

vocab.example: I double-check the schedule with the whole team before I promise a date.

vocab.example: We had to regain trust with weekly progress calls for two months.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi phải lấy lại niềm tin bằng các cuộc gọi báo tiến độ hằng tuần trong hai tháng.

vocab.meaning_vi: áp dụng bài học đã rút ra
vocab.example: I apply the lesson by raising risks before they become real problems.

listening.title: Interview question: tell me about a failure

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: Nam, can you tell me about a time when a project did not go well?

lines.speaker: Nam (candidate)
lines.text: Yes. Last year I led a small website project and we fell short of the deadline.

lines.speaker: Nam (candidate)
lines.text: I underestimated the testing time, so we found many bugs in the final week.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: How did you handle it with your manager?

lines.speaker: Nam (candidate)
lines.text: I went to her early to admit a mistake instead of hiding the problem.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: And how did the client react?

lines.speaker: Nam (candidate)
lines.text: They were not happy, so we had to regain trust with weekly progress calls.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: What did you change after that project?

lines.speaker: Nam (candidate)
lines.text: Now I double-check the schedule with the whole team and speak up early about risks.

lines.speaker: Hoa (interviewer)
lines.text: That is a useful lesson. Do you see any warning signs in your current team?

lines.speaker: Nam (candidate)
lines.text: Yes, and I apply the lesson by raising them in our weekly planning meeting.

questions.q: What was the main problem in Nam’s project?
What did Nam do when he saw the delay?
How does Nam apply the lesson today?
options: He raises risks in weekly planning

shadowing: I led a small website project, and we fell short of the original deadline.
I underestimated the testing time, so many bugs appeared in the final week.
I admitted the mistake to my manager early instead of hiding the real problem.
We regained the client trust with weekly calls and a clear recovery plan.
Today I double-check the schedule and speak up early about any warning signs.
